# NDDev fonts

`manifest.json` is the contract for every product: the families, the token each serves, the scripts it covers and its licence (all OFL-1.1).

- **Web**: install the exact `@fontsource` packages the manifest names, serve the listed WOFF2 files (each checked by its SHA-256) as `@font-face` rules with their `unicode-range`, preload the files of a script's first view (`preload`), and load `text-styles.css`, which declares the fallback face (`fallback`: Arial scaled so the swap to Plex moves a line as little as possible).
- **Native**: `ttf/` holds IBM Plex Sans and IBM Plex Sans Arabic at 400, 500 and 600 from IBM's release (digests in the manifest, licence alongside). The Swift, Kotlin, Flutter and Rust packages bundle the same files. Chinese uses the system CJK face on native platforms (PingFang SC, Noto Sans CJK): Noto Sans SC would add some 17 MB to an app.

Consume a release: copy this directory from the tag `vX.Y.Z` into the product and record the tag and the directory digest (docs/adr/0001-architecture.md §13). Never edit the copy; update it from a newer tag.
